Research_3.spec: RDODI procedure v1.6.0, Stages 1-3 for chapter 3, built by 08-tooling/sen0414_rdodi_build_v1_1_0.py from 08-tooling/sen0414_ch03_rdodi_data_v1_0_0.py. Gates run with RDODI's own validator functions (rdodi_pipeline_validator_v1_6_0.py) by 08-tooling/sen0414_rdodi_gates_v1_1_0.py: Stage1.A-B, Stage2.A and C, Stage3.A, B, F, E.cov, E.sub and src, all PASS. 08-tooling/sen0414_rdodi_checks_v1_0_0.py executed 22 checks under Python 3.14.4 - 7 taxonomy examples, 3 further claims, 11 behaviours the text states, and the completeness of the TBox and ABox - with 0 mismatches, and HermiT found the TBox and ABox consistent. The reference gate's first run reported 11 claims uncited because it reads one '(Surname, Year)' per parenthesis with a capitalised first author; the citations were reformatted to that form, the sources and claims unchanged. The record was re-verified at 21:29:02 after a text fix to one concept section (the finding Finding_RetrievalNamesItself); the research was first verified at 20:10:54, the time recorded as the earliest its deck and page could begin. Stage 4 and the pedagogy stage are claimed by the chapter's page story.

Deck_3.spec: 08-tooling/ch03-deck/deck_check_v1_0_1.py (shared with chapter 2) re-ran all 12 expressions on the deck under Python 3.14.4, and 08-tooling/ch03-deck/program_check_v1_0_0.py re-ran all 10 program runs, several with more than one typed input, echoing prompt and typed value: 0 mismatches. Two fixtures refused, each naming what it broke: an expression result edited on slide 5, and a program transcript edited (the total of the summing program). 17 slides rendered and inspected; three layout faults fixed before closing - a caption running into a card, oversized import cards, and a guessing-game transcript running off its slide, so the game takes three attempts. The documentation section numbers on the slides were checked against the source's headings; one was wrong (Looping Techniques is 5.6, not 5.7) and was corrected. The first draft of the program check refused correct slides because it did not decode the file's character entities; the check was fixed, not the deck.

Page_3.release: the release carrying the chapter 3 page (sen0414-v2.28.0)
Page_3.spec: 08-tooling/sen0414_page_test_v9_5_0.py exercised every widget and feature of the chapter 3 page in headless Chromium: 37 of 37 widgets and 50 of 50 features passed, every executable example printed via Pyodide exactly what the build interpreter printed, 0 console errors, 0 WCAG 2 AA violations. The pedagogy stage's automated gates (wcag, model provenance, assessment rigor, Bloom coverage) pass. The Courseware profile's pedagogical-soundness attestation is the owner's, is not part of this story's definition of done, and is recorded as pending, not claimed. RDODI Stage 4: parse, shapes (0 violations) and source validity pass; the proposed coverage and substance gates and the navigation gate fail on this page exactly as on the published chapter 2 page - recorded in Finding_Stage4ProposedGatesOnPublishedPages, not claimed as passed. The page's own built-in checks and the Bloom gate each found a defect in the first build - a concept section retrieval misranked, an objective assessed a level below its own - and both were fixed (findings Finding_RetrievalNamesItself and Finding_BloomCoverageObjectiveFour). One test run met a rate limit (HTTP 429) on the embedding model's host and was repeated; the failing run is not counted.
